# Peak Bio-Clean

> Peak Bio-Clean is a licensed, insured, and bondable biohazard remediation company serving all of Florida, available 24/7. Owner Parker Peak runs the business directly — not a franchise or a call center. Services: crime scene cleanup, unattended death cleanup, trauma cleanup, suicide cleanup, blood cleanup, decomposition cleanup, biohazard waste disposal, hoarding cleanup, and 40+ related services. Compassionate, discreet, and coordinates directly with insurance. Phone: (407) 758-0682.

## Business facts

- Business name: Peak Bio-Clean
- Owner: Parker Peak
- Phone: (407) 758-0682 (24/7, including holidays)
- Email: info@peakbioclean.com
- Website: https://www.peakbioclean.com
- Licensed, insured, and bondable in Florida
- OSHA trained, EPA compliant
- Area served: All of Florida — all 67 counties (Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Hillsborough, and every county statewide)
- Services: crime scene cleanup, unattended death cleanup, suicide cleanup, trauma cleanup, blood cleanup, decomposition cleanup, biohazard waste disposal, hoarding cleanup, infectious disease cleanup, tear gas cleanup, rodent waste removal, sewage cleanup, and 40+ additional biohazard/cleanup/restoration services — see /services/
- Pricing: varies by situation and is often covered by homeowners, renters, or auto insurance with little to no out-of-pocket cost; Peak Bio-Clean documents every job and coordinates directly with the customer's insurance provider — see /insurance-and-cost/
- What makes them different: owner-operated (you deal directly with Parker Peak, not a call center or subcontractor), discreet unmarked vehicles and uniforms, compassionate and judgment-free approach, direct insurance coordination and documentation on every job

## Services

- [Crime Scene Cleanup](https://www.peakbioclean.com/crime-scene-cleanup/): Certified remediation of crime scenes once authorities have released the property.
- [Unattended Death Cleanup](https://www.peakbioclean.com/unattended-death-cleanup/): Discreet, compassionate cleanup after an unattended death.
- [Suicide Cleanup](https://www.peakbioclean.com/suicide-cleanup/): Respectful, confidential cleanup so families can begin to heal.
- [Trauma Cleanup](https://www.peakbioclean.com/trauma-cleanup/): Cleanup and restoration after a traumatic incident.
- [Blood Cleanup](https://www.peakbioclean.com/blood-cleanup/): Safe, OSHA-compliant blood and bodily-fluid cleanup.
- [Decomposition Cleanup](https://www.peakbioclean.com/decomposition-cleanup/): Decontamination and odor removal after decomposition.
- [Biohazard Waste Disposal](https://www.peakbioclean.com/biohazard-waste-disposal/): Licensed pickup, transport, and disposal of regulated biohazardous waste.
- [Hoarding Cleanup](https://www.peakbioclean.com/hoarding-cleanup/): Compassionate, judgment-free hoarding clean-outs.
- [All services](https://www.peakbioclean.com/services/): Full list of 50+ biohazard, crime scene, trauma, water/fire/mold, and cleaning services.
